body:
## Summary

Fixes the handwritten guest-name signature overlapping the episode title on carousel cards when a title is long enough to fill both clamped lines (currently only **EP05**). As diagnosed in #77, `.card-title` is clamped to 2 lines and EP05's title fills both, running under the absolutely-positioned `.episode-guest` signature.

This applies **option 3** (agreed with @XenonMolecule): a subtle frosted backdrop behind the signature so it stays legible over any title length, with no per-episode tuning.

## Change

Scoped entirely to `.episode-guest` in [`episodeCarousel.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss):

- Soft frosted pill — `color-mix(in srgb, var(--light) 82%, transparent)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(3px)` (themed, works in light/dark).
- `text-shadow` halo in `var(--light)` to lift the glyphs off the title text.
- Small `padding` + `border-radius` for the pill shape — no heavy badge look, preserves the floating-signature aesthetic.

No `guestOffset` changes were needed; ep02–ep04 (single-line titles) are visually unaffected.

## Preview / sequencing

- This PR is based on the **EP5 branch** (`agent/implement-issue-75/claude-27244386885`), not `main`, so the surge.sh deploy preview renders EP05 **and** the fix together — the only way to see the long-title card. The diff here is just the `.episode-guest` change.
- The Sepo preview bot will post the preview URL automatically once the build deploys.
- After EP5 (#77) merges to `main`, GitHub will auto-retarget this PR to `main` so it ships immediately after.

## Verification

- `quartz build` compiles cleanly; confirmed the new `.episode-guest` rules are present in the emitted `public/index.css`.
- Visual confirmation of legibility at desktop (300px) and mobile (260px/240px) widths is intended via the attached surge.sh preview.

Closes #78
title: Fix guest-name overlap on long-title carousel cards
